title: Canonical comparison of completed pullback presentations and coefficient maps
statement: Let $d=(A,I)$ be an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and let $h:S\to T$ be a morphism of schemes. Write $A_V=\varprojlim_n(A/I^{n+1})_V$. The completed coefficient structure map $c_h:h^{-1}A_T\to A_S$ of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] is the map whose projection at every level is inverse image of the quotient projection followed by the canonical finite constant-coefficient comparison. Identify this map with the coefficient map used by the datum's pullback; both have these same finite projections. Let $K_T$ be the canonical reduction-tower functor [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], let $Lh^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}$ be the K-flat derived strict-tower pullback [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], and let $h^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}$ be the exact derived termwise presentation of the same functor. Use their unique universal-resolving-counit-normalized comparison $t_h:Lh^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}\xrightarrow{\sim}h^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}$ [def-cbc-completed-pullback-counit-transport] and the specified functor $\operatorname{Rlim}_S$ [def-pur-completed-rlim-functor]. Define the completed presentation comparison to be the natural isomorphism $K_T\mathbin{\circ}Lh^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}\mathbin{\circ}\operatorname{Rlim}_S\xrightarrow{\ K_T\,t_h\,\operatorname{Rlim}_S\ }K_T\mathbin{\circ}h^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}\mathbin{\circ}\operatorname{Rlim}_S$, where these compositions are read in functor application order. No completeness, properness, smoothness, open immersion or cohomological bound is assumed.
